decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-a4f8422ce445] describes one change: in the Argo CD web UI, the Argo logo is now a link to the start page. It is listed as a feature in the 3.0.0 changelog. That is enough to set the subject (the logo element in the UI) and applicability (any installation where the web UI is used, with no other condition). Nothing in the text points to a different consequence: the logo simply becomes clickable. The proposals left subject and applicability open because the subject families don't fit UI elements well, not because the evidence is unclear.
